MitigationGoal.description:
A mitigation goal from the mitigation goal catalog.

A mitigation goal is a security objective assessed against every service.

createTime.description: UTC timestamp when the goal was added to the catalog.

category.description: The security domain this mitigation goal belongs to.

replaces.description: Ids of predecessor mitigation goals this entry replaces; content previously derived from a predecessor may be re-issued under this goal.

MitigationGoal.title: MitigationGoal

MitigationGoalCategory.description:
The security domain a mitigation goal belongs to, used to group related goals. Each goal has exactly one category; OTHER indicates no listed domain fits.

Values:
- ENCRYPTION: Encrypts data at rest or in transit, including key management.
- PERMISSIONS_AND_IDENTITY: Governs who and what can access resources: authentication, authorization, and data perimeters.
- NETWORK: Controls network placement, reachability, and traffic boundaries.
- LOGGING: Captures activity or data-access logs.
- MONITORING_AND_METRICS: Emits metrics or telemetry for operational and security monitoring.
- DATA_RETENTION_AND_RESILIENCE: Preserves data and resources: backups, replication, and protection against deletion.
- TAGGING: Applies resource tags for ownership and governance.
- CODE_INTEGRITY: Ensures a resource runs only trusted, reviewed, or signed code or content.
- OTHER: Does not fit a listed security domain.
